title: Pre-Registration: EFC dN/dM (z>7) Halo Mass Function via µ(a) Perturbation Channel
abstract: Sealed pre-registration of an Energy-Flow Cosmology (EFC) prediction for the high-redshift (z=7–12) halo mass function n(M,z) derived through the µ(a) perturbation channel. The work locks the structural chain g(a) → µ(a) → D(a) → σ(M,z) → n(M,z), specifies datasets and falsification criteria, and commits to three HMF prescriptions (Press–Schechter, Sheth–Tormen, Tinker) under identical baryonic mapping to isolate the cosmology channel.
